body.statement: Does the prefix-extremizer rank-state handle yield a finite set \(\mathsf T\), a renormalized geometric predecessor for every row in \(\mathcal H_{L+1}\), and one fixed program \(S_\star\) with \(\mathsf{CHECK}_{2\mathrm{BTAS}}(S_\star)=1\) such that, for every \(L\ge2\), the output multiset satisfies \(\operatorname{Out}_L(S_\star)=\mathcal H_L\) with multiplicity one, every emitted row is sound, and every canonical cut or weighted facet is emitted? The derived predecessor must give inverse type-labelled successors and include every staircase word from \(\text{def:staircase-family}\).
body.justification: This is the theorem-level kernel: it upgrades finite hull computation to a uniform analytic and uniquely enumerable facet system.
body.gap: Russell2021 supplies a general sharp-bound program for continuous functionals of the joint law of two potential outcomes, DuarteEtAl2024 gives generic sharp numerical optimization, AvisFukuda1996 gives abstract reverse search, and KaidoPonomarev2025 gives graph-based support inequalities. None proves a dimension-uniform facet grammar after a genuinely three-marginal forbidden-support deletion under the stated syntactic restriction.
body.consumer: The complete stream makes every sharp unique-best endpoint auditable and reproducible for arbitrary prespecified ordinal resolution.

obligation.what_is_open: Construct or refute a finite geometric type set \(\mathsf T\), a renormalized predecessor on every row of \(\mathcal H_{L+1}\), and an explicit fixed sixteen-register source \(S_\star\) whose accepted traces are sound, complete, and unique for every \(L\).
obligation.obstruction: The synthesis handle names prefix and suffix argmin sets and rank increments but supplies no finite quotient, transition table, register program, or invariant proving that every facet enters one of finitely many successor types. The all-length staircase proof does not classify facets outside that family.
obligation.attempted: I proved validity, primitivity, facet rank, injectivity, and the doubling and Fibonacci specializations for every staircase word. The direct letter updates include both opposing shear directions, so no fixed order of the two obvious endpoint registers is triangular; this does not exclude a different encoding using the allowed sixteen registers. Finite catalogues through small support cannot establish the all-length bijection.
obligation.partial_result: The full-dimensionality and staircase proof above establishes, for every \(L\ge3\), an injective family of \(3^{L-3}\) primitive weighted facets, including the doubling and alternating-Fibonacci subfamilies.  Within this family, deleting the terminal letter and reinstating a terminal \(\mathrm D\) gives a unique geometric predecessor with three inverse successors.  This is a one-type transfer law for the staircase subfamily, but it neither classifies \(\mathcal H_L\) nor supplies a compliant source \(S_\star\).
